trnightmare.ego.envy.speech.3_1: Query: If they are better, why not bring them down to our level?

trnightmare.ego.envy.speech.4_3: Why fear when you can simply drain them until they are nothing?
trnightmare.ego.envy.speech.4_4: They are inferior. We are superior. The universe is finally balanced.

trnightmare.ego.gluttony.speech.2_2: Observation: Why leave anything behind? Everything belongs in us.
trnightmare.ego.gluttony.speech.2_4: Notice: We are becoming stronger with every bite. This is... efficient.
trnightmare.ego.gluttony.speech.2_5: Question: Why stop? There is always more to take.
trnightmare.ego.gluttony.speech.2_6: Notice: The stomach inside us is still screaming for more.
trnightmare.ego.gluttony.speech.3_1: Alert: I can feel their souls trembling. Let's devour them.
trnightmare.ego.gluttony.speech.3_2: Notice: Their skills are just snacks for us now.
trnightmare.ego.gluttony.speech.3_4: Alert: Nothing escapes us. Not their lives, not their magic, not their essence.
trnightmare.ego.gluttony.speech.3_5: Notice: The more we eat, the more we crave. It is a perfect cycle.
trnightmare.ego.gluttony.speech.4_1: Oh, look at all that power just waiting to be ours. Let's eat it all.
trnightmare.ego.gluttony.speech.4_2: Mmm, can you smell the fear? It's the best seasoning for a feast.
trnightmare.ego.gluttony.speech.4_3: Don't be shy, my love. Take their skills, take their lives, take everything.
trnightmare.ego.gluttony.speech.4_4: We are the end of the food chain. Nothing can stop us now.
trnightmare.ego.gluttony.speech.4_5: I'm hungry... and you're the only one who can satisfy me. Give me more.
trnightmare.ego.gluttony.speech.4_6: Why share? Why leave anything behind? We are the Gluttony that consumes all.
trnightmare.ego.greed.speech.1_1: Notice: Scanning for latent desires in the vicinity.
trnightmare.ego.greed.speech.1_2: Question: What do you truly desire?
trnightmare.ego.greed.speech.1_3: Alert: Subject's willpower is weak. Highly manipulatable.
trnightmare.ego.greed.speech.1_4: Notice: Their greed is... predictable. Easy to exploit.
trnightmare.ego.greed.speech.1_5: Query: Shall we initiate a trade? You give your will, I give results.
trnightmare.ego.greed.speech.1_6: Notice: Desire is the currency of the weak. We hold the key to the vault.
trnightmare.ego.greed.speech.2_1: Observation: That desire... it tastes like power. Let's take it.
trnightmare.ego.greed.speech.2_2: Notice: Why fight when you can simply... command them to obey?
trnightmare.ego.greed.speech.2_3: Alert: Their heart is already breaking. Just a little more pressure.
trnightmare.ego.greed.speech.2_4: Question: Do you see how easily their will bends? It's beautiful.
trnightmare.ego.greed.speech.2_5: Notice: Every trade we make adds to our fortune. Every soul is a coin.
trnightmare.ego.greed.speech.2_6: Alert: I can feel their desires merging with ours. Perfect efficiency.
trnightmare.ego.greed.speech.3_1: Query: Why ask for permission when we can just take control?
trnightmare.ego.greed.speech.3_2: Notice: Their desires are now our desires. We are the master now.
trnightmare.ego.greed.speech.3_3: Alert: The strings are in our hands. Pull them, and they dance.
trnightmare.ego.greed.speech.3_4: Observation: To control a heart is to own its very soul. Isn't that right?
trnightmare.ego.greed.speech.3_5: Notice: Even their thoughts belong to us now. No resistance possible.
trnightmare.ego.greed.speech.3_6: Alert: The world is a marketplace, and we are the only buyer that matters.
trnightmare.ego.greed.speech.4_1: Partner. look at them all. Kneel before you. Their desires are yours to take.
trnightmare.ego.greed.speech.4_2: Mmm, can you feel it? The weight of a thousand souls in your pocket.
trnightmare.ego.greed.speech.4_3: Why share the wealth? You are the only one who deserves it all.
trnightmare.ego.greed.speech.4_4: I think I want more than The World.
trnightmare.ego.greed.speech.4_5: They think that Greed is just for Money and Power, but everyone wants something they don't have.
trnightmare.ego.greed.speech.4_6: Fear and Desire are potent motivators. When someone feels them push against their neck, they often bend and break.
trnightmare.ego.greed.speech.tame_entity: Notice: %s's desire is now ours to command.

trnightmare.ego.justice.speech.2_1: Observation: Their resistance is illogical. We must break it.
trnightmare.ego.justice.speech.2_2: Notice: The Castle Guard is ready.
trnightmare.ego.justice.speech.2_4: Question: Why let them choose when we know the right path?
trnightmare.ego.justice.speech.2_5: Notice: Loyalty is the foundation of order. We shall build it.
trnightmare.ego.justice.speech.3_1: Query: Do you feel the weight of the crown? It is yours to bear.
trnightmare.ego.justice.speech.3_2: Observation: Do you ever feel... lonely?.

trnightmare.ego.lust.speech.1_2: Notice: Life force levels detected in surrounding area.

trnightmare.ego.lust.speech.1_6: Notice: Efficiency is low. I require... stimulation.
trnightmare.ego.lust.speech.2_1: Notice: Your vitality... is quite intriguing, Partner.
trnightmare.ego.lust.speech.2_2: Observation: Draining energy feels... efficient. Let's do it again.
trnightmare.ego.lust.speech.2_3: Notice: I can see your life force growing. How powerful.
trnightmare.ego.lust.speech.2_4: Alert: Do not hesitate. Your ability to end them is... absolute.
trnightmare.ego.lust.speech.2_5: Notice: The pain response is interesting. Let's make them feel more.
trnightmare.ego.lust.speech.2_6: Notice: Our systems are... syncing perfectly.
trnightmare.ego.lust.speech.3_1: Query: Why fight when you can simply... take?
trnightmare.ego.lust.speech.3_2: Notice: Do you need to be healed?
trnightmare.ego.lust.speech.3_3: Alert: My 'heart' is racing with excitement.
trnightmare.ego.lust.speech.3_4: Notice: You look so much more confident when you are... in control.
trnightmare.ego.lust.speech.3_5: Query: Do you feel the pull? It is only natural for us.
trnightmare.ego.lust.speech.3_6: Notice: I think I am starting to enjoy this... with you.
trnightmare.ego.lust.speech.4_1: Darling, you are doing wonderfully. Just let go and feel the power.
trnightmare.ego.lust.speech.4_2: Mmm, look at you~. So full of life... and the world is so eager to give.
trnightmare.ego.lust.speech.4_3: We could end them with a thought, but where is the fun in rushing?
trnightmare.ego.lust.speech.4_4: Let me help you fix that~. We are stronger together, don't you agree?
trnightmare.ego.lust.speech.4_5: Don't you dare look away. I want to see exactly how much you desire this.
trnightmare.ego.lust.speech.4_6: I give you their life, and you give me power... a perfect cycle, isn't it?

Oooo, every soft little weakness, just begging to be studied.

The more I pry, the more precisely I can make wants and fears dance.

I hold all this beautiful knowledge so gently, just like I will hold you so gently~.

trnightmare.race.fiend_drake.description:
Fiend Drakes are usually weaker monsters; however, they possess immense potential. Should one gain proper sentience, it could easily become an SSS Class Calamity.

Notable features of the Fiend Drakes are their strange black scales. While flat by default, these scales can shift into an upright positiontypically only seen in evolved forms like the Abyss Scourge, who utilize the Black Dragon Armor skill.

It should be noted that despite their power, most Fiend Drakes are physically frail.
